description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Bill the Pony.
When Bill the Pony enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Foods.
